method: Real impact of players with little or no NBA track record, when they do play (Basketball Index LEBRON). For each player-season s (2011-2026, 250+ minutes): the player's NBA minutes in the three seasons before s (Basketball Reference). Groups: none (<1), thin (1-249), 250-999, 1000-1999, 2000+. First-round picks are left out of the first two groups (they are the rookie translation's job). Mean O-/D-LEBRON in s, unweighted. Players who never got 250 minutes are missing, so the low groups' means are an upper bound on their level.
sources: Basketball Index LEBRON by season 2010-2026 (fanspo tools capture, local)
